question: Which coach received the Dronacharya Award for shooting in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepali Deshpande**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** announced the **National Sports Awards** for the year **2024**, which were conferred by the **President of India** at **Rashtrapati Bhavan** in early **2025**. 
• **Deepali Deshpande** was honored with the **Dronacharya Award** in the **Regular Category** for her exceptional contribution to **Shooting**. 
• As a high-performance coach, she played a pivotal role in training elite Indian shooters, most notably **Swapnil Kusale**, who secured a **Bronze medal** in the **50m Rifle 3 Positions** at the Paris 2024 Olym
